_comment: Template for the MCP servers this skill uses. Copy the relevant entries into your agent's MCP config (Claude Code: .mcp.json at the project root, or `claude mcp add`), then fill in the redacted credentials for sdk-docs and ludeo-context — ludeo-mcp needs none, it signs in with OAuth. For sdk-docs, set X-User-Name to your Ludeo username (the local-part of your Ludeo email, e.g. jane.doe) — it identifies the caller. All three are optional. sdk-docs and ludeo-context fall back to the bundled references/; ludeo-mcp falls back to asking the human to do the step in Studio Labs (see SKILL.md → Check MCP Servers). Ask the Ludeo integrations team for current URLs and credentials for those two.

sdk-docs._purpose: Search the Ludeo SDK documentation — API reference, method signatures, parameter structs, callback chains. Primary source for SDK details at any phase. Fallback: bundled references/sdk-reference/ (concepts only) plus grepping the installed plugin headers under Plugins/LudeoUESDK/Source/ for exact signatures.

ludeo-context._purpose: Ludeo company knowledge base — integration templates, QA workflows, event lists, repo context. Most useful for Phase 1 (architecture analysis) and Phases 4-5 (action discovery from QA event lists). Fallback: proceed without; analysis quality may be reduced.

ludeo-mcp._purpose: Automates Studio Labs platform work the agent otherwise hands to the human (environments, beta version, ...). Touchpoints, cadence, and the read/write policy: references/ludeo-studio-mcp.md. Fallback: ask the human to do the step in Studio Labs.
ludeo-mcp._auth_note: No token to paste — the server signs in with OAuth. The client prompts the human to log in with their Studio Labs account (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate). A staging deployment may appear as ludeo-mcp-staging; identify the server by its tools (list_game_environments, ping). A staging-only connection doesn't count for a studio's game: add this production entry.
